channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year
item.description: A holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination with international artists
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation on the historic Crain Estate in Fort Pierce offers tours three days a week and hosts an artist-in-residency program attracting creators from around the world.

item.title: Port St. Lucie works to expand Midway Road and add Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange at the Florida Turnpike.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue two after boat sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters were rescued Wednesday after their small motorized boat sank in the Intracoastal Waterway. Life jackets kept them afloat until help arrived.

item.title: Hobe Sound community rallies around man who lost fiance in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, died Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild.

item.title: Breast cancer patient speaks out after insurance denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, was diagnosed with invasive ductal carcinoma three months ago. Her insurance company, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, denied coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4 percent this year across the Treasure Coast
item.description: A Fourth of July meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation that doubles slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation project expected to be complete by next Fourth of July. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: The 44-year-old Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday after injuring her right knee during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina survives Cape Verde scare 3-2 in World Cup Round of 16 thriller
item.description: Defending World Cup champion Argentina advanced to face Egypt after beating Cape Verde 3-2 in extra time, with Lionel Messi scoring his record-extending 20th career World Cup goal.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football targets state title after 10-2 season and district championship
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football team is targeting a state championship during the 2026 fall season after finishing last year with a 10-2 record and winning the district title. item.description:

item.title: Florida Secretary of State seeks to bar Rep. Paula Stark from ballot over missing financial disclosure
item.description: Secretary of State Cord Byrd is asking a Leon Circuit Court to keep Rep. Paula Stark off the ballot after the St. Cloud Republican failed to properly submit required financial disclosure paperwork before the qualifying deadline.

item.title: Florida students reach historic milestone with 60% scoring at grade level in reading and math
item.description: For the first time in state history, 60% of Florida students tested at or above grade level in both reading and math on the annual FAST exam, marking a significant increase from just three years ago.

item.title: Four Florida municipalities receive $7.2 million in FEMA grants for Hurricane Ian recovery projects
item.description: FloridaCommerce announced $7.2 million in federal grants for Charlotte County, Port of the Islands, Seminole County, and Palatka to fund infrastructure projects and improve storm preparedness nearly four years after Hurricane Ian.

item.title: U.S. men's soccer team faces Belgium in World Cup knockout round after defeating Bosnia
item.description: The United States men's national team takes the field Monday night against Belgium in the Round of 16 at Lumen Field in Seattle, having earned the program's first knockout stage victory since 2002.

item.title: Americans mark 250th Independence Day with tempered enthusiasm and local focus
item.description: As the United States celebrates its 250th birthday, many Americans interviewed by the Associated Press are tuning out partisan shouting and focusing instead on personal concepts of resilience, local community, and the freedom they enjoy.

item.title: Thomas Jefferson's contradictory legacy debated as nation marks 250th anniversary
item.description: As the United States celebrates its 250th year, historians say no founder's life and work resonates like Thomas Jefferson's, who embodied both the best and worst of the nation and advanced both sides of issues that have defined the country's path.
